outcome: organ dysfunction (renal, respiratory, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, hepatic, hematological)
cohort: 152 asphyxiated newborns delivered at Pravara Institute of Medical Sciences, Loni, excluding those born before 37 weeks of gestation, born outside the hospital, with congenital anomalies, or with early onset sepsis.
finding: The most common organ dysfunctions other than CNS involvement in asphyxiated newborns were renal (64%), respiratory (45%), cardiovascular (32%), and gastrointestinal (16%), with an overall mortality rate of 37.5%.
